title: Investigating planar Proca metamaterials in nonlinear (2+1)-Electrodynamics
summary: The present work pursues the investigation of the physics of a planar electromagnetic system incorporating nonlinear effects, as well as de Broglie-Proca and Chern-Simons mass terms in vacuum, which can be tuned to describe new planar metamaterials (MTMs) potentially suitable for technological applications. As a result, we observe interesting effects generated by a spatially dispersive profile that emerges from non-linearity.
